parameters.help_en: The list of routing rules, specified as a JSON array string. Usage note: Correct the value of FallbackMode in the RouteRules parameter example by replacing it with a valid value or removing the field, and add the list of valid values and their descriptions for the FallbackMode subfield in the description of RouteRules
parameters.help_zh: 路由规则列表（JSON 数组字符串）。调用说明：修正 RouteRules 参数示例中的 FallbackMode 取值（替换为实际合法值或移除该字段），并在 RouteRules 的 description 中补充 FallbackMode 子字段的有效取值列表及含义
parameters.name: route_rules

parameters.help_en: The model name mappings, specified as a JSON array string. Each element is in the format of {"Source":"client model name","Target":"upstream model name"}. If you do not specify this parameter, the current mappings are retained. If you specify "[]", the mappings are cleared. The Source field is matched in a case-insensitive manner and must be unique
parameters.help_zh: 模型名映射，JSON 数组字符串，元素为 {"Source":"客户端模型名","Target":"上游模型名"}；不传保留现状，传 "[]" 清空映射。Source 按大小写不敏感匹配且不能重复
parameters.name: model_mappings

parameters.help_en: The intelligent routing candidate list, specified as a JSON object string in the format of {"AllowedModels":["candidate model name"]}. If you do not specify this parameter, the current list is retained. If you specify this parameter, the existing list is fully replaced with the new list. You cannot use an empty list to disable the feature. Saving candidates does not enable the feature. You must call EnableModelRouting first
parameters.help_zh: 智能路由候选列表，JSON 对象字符串，形如 {"AllowedModels":["候选模型名"]}；不传保留现状，传入时用完整候选列表全量替换，不能用空列表表达停用。保存候选不等于开通，需先调用 EnableModelRouting
parameters.name: model_routing
